patch_list: No-ops Blueshift's SDK initialisation, identification and event endpoints, so no campaign, push or in-app-message engagement data is sent. Off by default: Blueshift also drives rich push and the in-app inbox, so enabling this can stop in-a…

No-ops the crash-reporting (Sentry), attribution (Singular), the app-owned analytics event sink and the Crashlytics user-identity custom keys, so no crash report, install-attribution or usage event is sent and no username or membership fla…
Skillshare ships no ad SDK or ad placement; this additionally disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.

Forces the app's client-side entitlement flags (isMember → true, isLocked → false) so premium badges, paywall CTAs and locked-lesson chrome are gone and every lesson row is playable/downloadable in the UI. Honestly: the video stream itself…
